english.title: Interfere with water meter to prevent accurate measure of consumption of water/discharge of effluent from premises
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without appropriate consent, so interfered with a meter used by a

(A)_[relevant water undertaker,]_
(B)_[water supplier licensee,]_
(C)_[sewerage licensee,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY UNDERTAKER, SUPPLIER OR LICENSEE..), in determining the amount of charges fixed in relation to premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) as intentionally or recklessly to prevent the meter from showing, or from accurately showing, the volume of water supplied to, or of effluent discharged from, those premises
english.legislation: Contrary to section 175(1)(a) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
without appropriate consent
so interfered with a meter,
used by a relevant water undertaker or licensed water supplier or sewerage licensee in determining the amount of charges fixed in relation to premises,
as intentionally or recklessly to prevent the meter from showing, or from accurately showing,
the volume of water supplied to, or of effluent discharged from, those premises
